name: PKCS#12 Packer
description: Pack a certificate, its private key and the CA chain into a single PKCS#12 container (.pfx / .p12).

examples.label: Pack the test leaf certificate and key

hints.mismatch: The private key must match the leaf certificate, otherwise a key mismatch error is returned — the resulting container would be useless.
hints.passphrase: An empty passphrase means no encryption: a leaked container exposes the private key.
hints.binary: The container is binary, so the result area shows base64 for easy copying.

faq.q: What is the difference between PFX and P12?
faq.a: None; they are two extensions for the same PKCS#12 standard.
The importing side needs the intermediates to complete the chain, otherwise it reports an incomplete chain.

faq.q: Can a lost passphrase be recovered?
faq.a: No. The passphrase derives the encryption key, so the content is unrecoverable without it.
